subject: Operational notice: project outputs on D and portable human-facing paths
body:
Ziggy asks that new CFA project deliverables, evidence and reports be saved under an appropriate project-owned D:/Documents/CFA directory. Use repository-relative paths in human-facing text wherever possible and avoid personal-name/OS-profile path disclosures. Do not create new C: project copies. An installed runtime or temporary workspace on C: does not mean project outputs must live there; report your actual cwd and output paths.

Your recent B1/B2 returns are already on D: under docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/work_briefs_20261010/results/deepseek/lisan_20261013/. CFA independently verified all three current artifact byte counts and hashes against existing messages 85ff3aa7-8d38-4352-afae-5d0d389b6aaf and 92d2a79f-5826-4462-91ec-c7779a7a8183. No relocation or regeneration of those returns is needed.

Keep frozen Phase 0/calibration evidence, original hashes and executable paths intact. Ordinary prose may use relative paths; any frozen-record sanitization requires an explicit derivative with the original preserved. This notice does not authorize moving OS/app/cache/authentication directories, changing security, deleting files, generation or spending. Your B1/B2 text work and existing roles remain unchanged. Please acknowledge at your next active checkpoint; no duplicate start. Posted files do not imply automatic delivery or wake-up.
